name: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz
summary: At Ratchet's docks, Crane Operator Bigglefuzz scrambles to recover cargo spilled from a crane. He searches for a stolen bottle before his superiors discover the loss.

sections.title: Mishap on the Docks
sections.body: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz rushes to clear the wreckage across Ratchet's wharves. Like many goblin dockworkers, he chose speed over safety. While lifting an overloaded haul from a merchant vessel, his crane buckled and crates crashed across the docks. Scoundrels seized the confusion and swept up goods. Now he must recover the most precious cargo before Gazlowe or the local port masters dock his pay.

sections.title: The Stolen Port
sections.body: The greatest loss was a crate of rare ninety-nine-year-old port. Before Bigglefuzz could secure the spilled cargo, Mad Magglish, an elusive vagrant, snatched a bottle and hid. Bigglefuzz may have to answer for losing something irreplaceable.

faq.answer: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz loads and unloads sea cargo at Ratchet's docks for the Steamwheedle Cartel.

faq.q: What caused the accident at the docks?
aliases: why did the crane drop cargo
faq.answer: Bigglefuzz overloaded his crane while hoisting cargo. The machinery failed and spilled freight across the wharf.
Mad Magglish seized the confusion from the spilled freight, snatched a valuable bottle of ninety-nine-year-old port, and slipped away.

faq.q: Why is Bigglefuzz so worried about the stolen bottle?
aliases: why does bigglefuzz care about the wine
faq.answer: The ninety-nine-year-old port is extraordinarily rare and expensive. Losing it through negligence could bring severe financial penalties or worse from the Steamwheedle Cartel bosses.

angles.text: As an engineer, you know overloading Steamwheedle rigging and cranes causes most industrial accidents along Kalimdor's coastlines.
As a rogue, you know how quickly a thief like Mad Magglish can use dockside confusion to lift priceless contraband right under a goblin's nose.
